VJCaustic
Player Glass Lift Shortcuts
Made for Video.js 10

A Video.js v10 skin made of light and glass. Every control bends the picture behind it, the way water throws caustic light.

Now playing Demo reel
OK

Glass that bends light.

The controls are not blurred boxes. A shader refracts the live video through every pane, so the picture curves at the edges, with a soft frost and a hint of color fringing.

A droplet on the timeline.

Hover the timeline and the playhead turns into a bead of clear glass that magnifies the track beneath it. Drag, and it stretches.

Pause, and it lifts.

The picture rises off the page as a slab of glass, lit by its own colors, and tilts toward your cursor. Press play and it settles back flat.

Readable over anything.

The glass watches the picture behind it. Over bright footage it deepens, so icons and time stay clear. Over dark footage it stays almost invisible.

Lit by the picture.

The light around the player, and the page itself, take their color from whatever is playing. Change the video and the whole room changes with it.

Every control, from the keyboard.

SpaceK
Play or pause
←→
Seek 5 seconds
JL
Seek 10 seconds
↑↓
Volume
M
Mute
F
Fullscreen
0to9
Jump to 0 to 90%
Tab
Move between controls

On touch screens, double tap the left or right side to skip 10 seconds.

Made for the Video.js Skins Challenge by Vajahat.

Built with Video.js v10, three.js and Mux. Source on GitHub, Apache 2.0.
